bead.title: Remove redundant sqlite-relational bespoke positive commit-transition test
bead.description:
PROBLEM
After the shared commit-transition scenario from governing artifact/dependency pqueue-c42136f3 is wired into sqlite-relational coverage, the bespoke sqlite-relational positive-path test remains and may duplicate or diverge from the shared contract.

ROOT CAUSE
crates/pqueue-sqlite/tests/relational_commit.rs:134 defines relational_commit_writes_side_records_enqueues_lifecycle_finalizes_and_survives_reopen, a bespoke positive-path test intended to be covered by the shared scenario.

PROPOSED FIX
After pqueue-c42136f3 and the child bead wiring sqlite positive coverage are complete, delete only relational_commit_writes_side_records_enqueues_lifecycle_finalizes_and_survives_reopen from crates/pqueue-sqlite/tests/relational_commit.rs. Confirm the shared sqlite-relational scenario covers side records, enqueue lifecycle, finalization, and reopen survival before deletion. Leave tests whose behavior is not covered by the shared scenario, including schema_validation_rejects_before_append_and_idempotency_on_sqlite_relational and other idempotency, bad-token/version, fence, capability, request-id propagation, or explain-commit coverage not proven redundant.

NON-SCOPE
Do not implement real CommitTransitionPort behavior for postgres/objectlog; that is a separate epic. Do not delete any bespoke test unless its exact behavior is covered by the shared harness. Do not delete schema_validation_rejects_before_append_and_idempotency_on_sqlite_relational. Do not relax any verification gate. Do not remove pqueue-0ef6807b postgres/objectlog bespoke decline tests in this bead unless the shared decline harness has already been wired and the deletion is proven behavior-preserving.

DEPENDENCIES
Requires pqueue-c42136f3 and completion of the child bead wiring sqlite positive coverage. Parent: pqueue-54039317. Split from parent bead pqueue-d2f0b763.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestSqliteRelationalBespokePositiveRemoved: `rg -c 'fn relational_commit_writes_side_records' crates/pqueue-sqlite/tests/relational_commit.rs` returns `0` after the shared sqlite-relational scenario covers that positive path.
2. TestSqliteNonScopeRetained: `rg -c 'fn schema_validation_rejects_before_append_and_idempotency_on_sqlite_relational' crates/pqueue-sqlite/tests/relational_commit.rs` returns `1`, and idempotency, bad-token/version, fence, capability, request-id propagation, and explain-commit tests not proven redundant remain present.
3. TestCargoWorkspaceGate: `cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features` passes after the deletion.
4. TestGoWorkspaceGate: `go test ./...` passes or is documented as not applicable because the repository has no Go packages.
5. TestLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
6. TestRustStyleGate: `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` pass.
